$schema.description: Editor hint only; ignored by the loader.

notes.description: Why these values (feel targets, references), for owner review.

height.description: Standing capsule height, feet to crown, m; at least 2 × radius.

crouchHeight.description: Crouched capsule height, m; at least 2 × radius and at most height. The feet stay put, the top lowers.

capsule.description: The player’s collision capsule (vertical, feet at the character position).

run.description: Top speed with the move input fully deflected, m/s. Partial input walks.

sprint.description: Top speed while sprint is held, m/s; at least run.

crouch.description: Top speed while crouched, m/s; at most run.

speeds.description: Top ground speeds, m/s. Analog input scales them (half deflection = half speed).

accelTime.description: Time to reach run speed from rest on the ground, s.

decelTime.description: Time to stop from run speed on the ground once input is released, s.

airControl.description: Share of ground acceleration available in the air, 0–1; with no input the player keeps momentum.

jumpApex.description: Jump height from standing, feet to feet, m.

coyoteMs.description: After walking off a ledge a jump still works for this long, whole ms (≤ 120).

jumpBufferMs.description: A jump pressed this long before landing fires on landing, whole ms (≤ 150).

stepHeight.description: Tallest step walked up without jumping, m; also how far the player snaps down to stay on stairs and ramps. Below crouchHeight.

slopeLimit.description: Steepest walkable slope, degrees; steeper ground is a wall the player slides off.
